dares.title: The little things
dares.description: Find something that makes you smile. Share a photo and the story behind it.
rules: Choose an object, a view, or a small detail — never a stranger’s face.
No faces, addresses, documents, or identifying details in your photo.
Share only what you’re comfortable with. You can skip or leave anytime.

dares.title: Drawn together
dares.description: Pick a word together. Make a tiny doodle, then share your masterpieces.
rules: Keep your word and drawing kind, respectful, and suitable for everyone.
No artistic skills needed — and no pressure to share an image.
Stay in the app. Never share your address, phone number, or private details.
